published_evidence.exploitation_evidence: The attacker repeatedly transfers the key back to themselves from the victim without clearing the previous approval after the key transfer.
published_evidence.fix_strategy_evidence: Call the _clearApproval function to clear the approval.
published_evidence.root_cause_evidence: The _setKeyManagerOf function does not clear single-token approvals.
